errors.empty_allowlist: Restricted mode needs at least one domain: pick an allowlist or type some domains.
errors.goal_required: State what you intend to do first.
errors.invalid_duration: Could not read the duration "{text}". Try 25, 25m, 1h30 or 1:30.
errors.invalid_targets: Not a valid domain or address: {list}
errors.no_pkexec: pkexec is not installed, so network access cannot be changed.

notify.expired_body: Your time for "{goal}" is over. What's next?
notify.title: Intention

prompt.heading: What do you intend to do?
prompt.hint: Enter start · Tab next field · Ctrl+1/2/3 network · Alt+1–5 recent · Ctrl+E +5 min · Ctrl+Q done
prompt.hint_no_network: Enter start · Tab next field · Alt+1–5 recent · Ctrl+E +5 min · Ctrl+Q done
prompt.network_auth: Changing network access asks for your password.

allowlist_dir.description: Folder holding allowlists, one *.txt file per list with one domain per line. Empty uses the plugin's data folder.
allowlist_dir.label: Allowlist folder

default_duration.description: Duration used when the prompt's duration field is left empty, e.g. 25m or 1h. Leave empty for no time limit.
default_duration.label: Default duration

default_network.description: Internet access preselected when there is no previous session.
default_network.label: Default internet access

enforce.description: Reopen the prompt whenever it is dismissed while no intention is set.
enforce.label: Insist on an intention

helper_path.description: Network helper run through pkexec. Empty uses the copy bundled with the plugin; point this at a root-owned copy (e.g. /usr/local/bin/intention-net) for a safer setup.
helper_path.label: Network helper path

keep_log.description: Append each finished session to log.jsonl in the plugin's data folder.
keep_log.label: Keep a session log

max_length.description: Truncate the goal after this many characters. 0 shows it in full.
max_length.label: Maximum goal length

network_control.description: Offer full, restricted, or no internet access per session. Changing it asks for your password through pkexec.
network_control.label: Control internet access

pause_when_idle.description: Stop the countdown while you are idle. Requires the idle hook described in the README.
pause_when_idle.label: Pause when idle

pause_when_locked.description: Stop the countdown while the screen is locked.
pause_when_locked.label: Pause when locked

prompt_on_startup.description: Ask for an intention when the shell starts.
prompt_on_startup.label: Prompt on startup

quit_action.description: What "Done for now" does after ending the session.
quit_action.label: When done

reopen_delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before showing the prompt again after it was dismissed.
reopen_delay_seconds.label: Reopen delay

reset_network_on_done.description: Restore full internet access when you end the day with "Done for now".
reset_network_on_done.label: Restore access when done

show_network.description: Show an icon while internet access is restricted or off.
show_network.label: Show network mode

show_seconds.description: Show the remaining or elapsed time to the second. Off shows whole minutes.
show_seconds.label: Show seconds

show_timer.description: Show the countdown, or the elapsed time for sessions without a limit.
show_timer.label: Show timer

time_format.description: How the remaining or elapsed time is written.
time_format.label: Time format

warn_minutes.description: Send a notification this many minutes before the time is up. 0 disables it.
warn_minutes.label: Warn before the end
